title: Die Propaedeutik der Araber im zehnten Jahrhundert (Arabic-German, Dieterici 1865 Quartile of arithmetic & music)
author: Ikhwan al-Safa
description: Die Propaedeutik der Araber im zehnten Jahrhundert (The Propaedeutics of the Arabs in the Tenth Century) by Friedrich Dieterici (Berlin, 1865), part of his multi-volume series on the philosophy of the Arabs in the tenth century, presenting in German translation and study the opening epistles of the encyclopedia of the Ikhwan al-Safa (Brethren of Purity) of Basra. The 'propaedeutic' sciences correspond to the mathematical quadrivium: arithmetic, geometry, astronomy and music. The index notes that this copy contains the arithmetic and music sections. The Brethren treat number in Pythagorean fashion as the key to the structure of the cosmos and the soul, and music as the harmony uniting the movements of the heavens, the human body and the soul, with discussions of musical theory and its healing and spiritual effects. It is an important source on Islamic Pythagoreanism and the esoteric philosophy of the Ikhwan.
